## Review course revisions in the browser

Open [Compare course revisions](course-compare.html) to choose an earlier and a revised checked course file, review their literal metadata, concept, question, answer and order changes, and keep an exact JSON comparison report. The page uses the native course-comparison helper without changing either course or any learner record. It distinguishes captured-byte equality from admitted-content equality and keeps correct-answer positions separate from correct-option text. The report includes full question records and answer keys plus reported differences; keep the original course files for complete metadata. See [browser comparison usage](docs/course-comparison-page.md) for local-file limits, replacement behavior and privacy.

reviewedBehaviors: Existing parseDeck is unchanged and every input is decoded fatally with a leading BOM preserved before parser admission.
File size is checked before reading and on the captured buffer; private copied bytes and text bind names, lengths and SHA-256.
Each role owns an independent request version. Actual replacement immediately retires reports, cancellation preserves state, late reads/digests cannot restore retired slots.
Compared content delegates to the separately owned comparison module. The wrapper preserves its result and captures its own raw-byte equality and file identity without rewriting course records.

Renderer uses textContent and native controls. Exact question IDs, source ordinals, options, answer-position/text flags and full question fields are preserved. Source change fixes the two missing whitespace rules.
Downloaded-report state remains captured and frozen; preparation failure retains it for explicit retry. No upload, automatic persistence, source mutation or learner write was found.
Builder is a deterministic local source bundler and rejects unsupported imports/exports. Actual owner177 syntax compatibility and generated-page equality remain unexecuted.
README is a775-byte append; removing it exactly restores the51,340-byte baseline Gitblob9bac51c2.
